displayName: SRM Intake - GSA pre-check on submit
description: Runs the Stage 1 GSA DUNS pre-check when a review request is added or its supplier, DUNS or No DUNS value changes: sets the pre-check outcome and review path, auto-closes the GSA reuse path, completes the supplier from D&B, notifies buyer and reviewer, and writes the ledger.
trigger: Dataverse: row added or modified on mag_financialreviewrequest (organization scope), filtered to mag_dunsnumber, mag_noduns and mag_supplierid; a trigger condition skips completed requests.
